An end-to-end quantitative genomics and molecular breeding suite for
crops. Identifies superior functional haplotypes from coding variants
under false discovery rate control and conducts haplotype-guided genomic
selection, analytical cross usefulness prediction, and linkage-aware
pyramiding optimization.

# Package index

## Pipeline: Superior Haplotype Discovery

End-to-end and modular tools for functional variant identification,
intragenic haplotype assembly, association testing, and gate
re-application. See
[`haplobreed_analysis()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/haplobreed_analysis.md)
for the single-trait pipeline; the remaining functions are the per-step
entry points.

- [`haplobreed_analysis()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/haplobreed_analysis.md)
  : Single-trait identification of genes carrying superior haplotypes
- [`hbr_check_inputs()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_check_inputs.md)
  : Pre-flight Validation of Inputs
- [`hbr_generate_input_qc_report()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_generate_input_qc_report.md)
  : Generate a unified input-QC report
- [`hbr_read_results()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_read_results.md)
  : Read HaploBreedR Pipeline Results from Disk
- [`hbr_gene_carriers()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_gene_carriers.md)
  : Carrier status of the superior haplotype at a gene
- [`hbr_regate()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_regate.md)
  : Re-apply Superior Haplotype Gates (Sensitivity Analysis)

## Genomic Selection & Breeding Decisions (HGSI)

Two-kernel spectral REML prediction, cross usefulness, multi-locus
pyramiding, haplotype-block calling, and parent-set optimization.
[`hbr_fit_models()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_fit_models.md)
and
[`hbr_cross_design()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_cross_design.md)
are the two halves of the pipeline;
[`hbr_advanced_decision()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_advanced_decision.md)
runs them end to end.

- [`hbr_advanced_decision()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_advanced_decision.md)
  : Breeding decisions from HaploBreedR output
- [`hbr_fit_models()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_fit_models.md)
  : Fit genomic prediction models and rank parents
- [`hbr_cross_design()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_cross_design.md)
  : Design crosses from a fitted model
- [`hbr_cross_plan()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_cross_plan.md)
  : Interactive Cross Query Planning
- [`hbr_cross_usefulness()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_cross_usefulness.md)
  : Analytical Cross Usefulness
- [`hbr_haplotype_blocks()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_haplotype_blocks.md)
  : Standalone Haplotype Block Calling
- [`hbr_haplotype_block_table()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_haplotype_block_table.md)
  : Haplotype block table from a set of target loci
- [`hbr_pyramid_probability()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_pyramid_probability.md)
  : Haplotype Pyramiding Probability
- [`hbr_population_size()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_population_size.md)
  : Population Size for Recombinant Recovery
- [`hbr_build_grm()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_build_grm.md)
  : Streamed Genomic Relationship Matrix
- [`hbr_reml_two_kernel()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_reml_two_kernel.md)
  : Spectral Two-Kernel REML
- [`hbr_trait_conflicts()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_trait_conflicts.md)
  : Multi-Trait Haplotype Breeding Conflicts

## Publication Figures & Visualisation

High-level ggplot2 publication graphics for candidate genes, haplotype
networks, gene models, LD structure, cross rankings, and model
validation.

- [`hbr_plot_haplotype()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_plot_haplotype.md)
  : Plot haplotype boxplot with summary table
- [`hbr_plot_gene_structure()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_plot_gene_structure.md)
  : Plot gene structure for one or more genes
- [`hbr_plot_haplotype_network()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_plot_haplotype_network.md)
  : Plot a haplotype network for one or more genes
- [`hbr_plot_cross_ranking()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_plot_cross_ranking.md)
  : Plot cross ranking by usefulness vs mid-parent index
- [`hbr_plot_cv_forest()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_plot_cv_forest.md)
  : Forest plot of cross-validation comparisons

## Variant Annotation & Population Genetics

LD decay estimation, GFF3 gene parsing, genomic-region interval
intersection, and GO term over-representation.

- [`hbr_annotate_regions_with_genes()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_annotate_regions_with_genes.md)
  : Annotate LD regions with genes
- [`hbr_read_gff3_genes()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_read_gff3_genes.md)
  : Parse gene features from a GFF3 into a data.table
- [`hbr_go_enrichment()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_go_enrichment.md)
  : GO term enrichment across a set of genes

## Manuscript Tables & Reporting

Formatted multi-sheet Excel manuscript tables built from a single
pipeline run.

- [`hbr_build_manuscript_tables()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_build_manuscript_tables.md)
  : Build a manuscript-ready multi-sheet Excel workbook from a pipeline
  run

## Reference Data, Themes & Lookups

Genetic linkage maps, crop genome metadata, colour palettes, and ggplot2
themes shipped with the package.

- [`hbr_rice_genetic_map()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_rice_genetic_map.md)
  : Bundled rice genetic map anchors
- [`hbr_crop_lookup()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_crop_lookup.md)
  : Common crops mapped to their Ensembl Plants species and assembly
- [`hbr_palette()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_palette.md)
  : Return \`n\` colours from a named palette
- [`hbr_palette_names()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_palette_names.md)
  : Names of the built-in colour palettes
- [`hbr_theme()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_theme.md)
  : Return a named HaploBreedR ggplot2 theme
- [`hbr_theme_names()`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/hbr_theme_names.md)
  : Names of the built-in ggplot2 themes

Print, summary, and plot methods for the classed objects the pipeline
returns.

- [`print(`*`<hbr_run>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_run.md)

  : Summary of an hbr_run object
- [`plot(`*`<hbr_run>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/plot.hbr_run.md)
  : Plot an hbr_run object
- [`print(`*`<hgsi_fit>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hgsi_fit.md)
  : Print an hgsi_fit object
- [`summary(`*`<hgsi_fit>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/summary.hgsi_fit.md)
  : Summarise an hgsi_fit object
- [`print(`*`<hgsi_advanced>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hgsi_advanced.md)
  : Print an hgsi_advanced object
- [`summary(`*`<hgsi_advanced>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/summary.hgsi_advanced.md)
  : Summarise an hgsi_advanced object
- [`plot(`*`<hgsi_advanced>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/plot.hgsi_advanced.md)
  : Plot an hgsi_advanced object

## S3 methods for reference and QC objects

Print methods for the small classed objects returned by the input
validation and reference-loading layers.

- [`print(`*`<hbr_reference>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_reference.md)
  : Print an hbr_reference object
- [`print(`*`<hbr_sequence_qc>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_sequence_qc.md)
  : Print a sequence-resource QC report
- [`print(`*`<hbr_compat_report>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_compat_report.md)
  : Print a genotype-reference compatibility report
- [`print(`*`<hbr_id_report>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_id_report.md)
  : Print an individual-ID match report
- [`print(`*`<hbr_genotype>`*`)`](https://github.com/aksruchi/HaploBreedR/reference/print.hbr_genotype.md)
  : Print an hbr_genotype object
